contexts.text: Reasoning from... mere hypotheses.

When anyone thinks about the soul from doctrine and at the same time from a hypothesis...

The shade of the reason, in which are hypotheses.

The hypothetical things about faith are... The hypothetical things about free will are...

Others can see that they are hypotheses.
Form for themselves various hypotheses about the soul...
In the sphere of such, Truths... are supposed to be... mere hypotheses.
From which are only ratiocinations, visions, fallacies thence, hypotheses, and thence phantasies...
That the things which are being written will appear as hypothetical things.
The flax-yellow colour of the garment = what is hypothetical.

From hypotheses concerning the soul...
God 4. 12. They have put forth hypotheses about the creation...
